name: reply-tree-thread
title: Reply Tree Thread
description: Discussion text structured as a tree: replies indent along ruled connector lines that draw in on expand, collapsed branches show reply counts, and the whole thread is keyboard-navigable with arrow keys.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Mosaic
Density: Dense
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Humanist
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Expand Collapse Tree: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
